headline: PAL Gladiator gains matching game helpers and easier disc-image access
summary: Contributors gain matching PAL SCES_532.85 code for drawing, point transforms, smoothing, object state and table lookups. A match compiles to the original game’s bytes. The day’s aggregate still reports 6.07% matched code and 4,475 of 18,085 functions without naming its release, so it should not be read as the PAL result.
highlights: #54 merges 30 PAL functions; #72 adds seventeen PAL hash lookups covering 1,952 retail bytes. #74 adds five PAL functions covering 128 bytes, and #75 adds 22 covering 1,056 bytes.
Contributors can supply a disc-image path for extraction and configuration without copying the ISO into the checkout; checking still uses extracted dumps (#56).
The 45 NTSC-U helpers in #71 remain a draft awaiting PAL mapping. PAL batches #55, #77, #78 and #79 are also open, not merged.
Issue #73 shares reconstruction evidence and remaining drafts. Its 13,713 generated ranges are explicitly not a count of decompiled functions.
